system.description: Lucky charms are endemic throughout the Empire, although their efficacy is extremely suspect. This one is a piece of stag's antler, purportedly that of a holy beast sacred to Taal. It has been well-worn by many fingers that would rub the antlers for luck. Encumbrance: 2 - Once per session, you may reroll all {Dm} and {Df} on a skill check.
